register.source_checks: The commit message says both certificates are replayed on both of the source's exact routes. It and the credit records certificates/n260.json and n307.json say neither packing is the author's construction: both refine the packings ntumlnoob published in the Kaggle notebook 'First 22.268681355 Public Code With Explanation' (run 362957087, sides 16.638533455862 and 17.979253973651 by its metric), and the gains, 6.6e-7 and 2.7e-6, come from the web app's fq, an adaptation of Evan Daniel's fq optimizer (MIT). The commit ends with a Co-Authored-By trailer naming Claude. Those statements are the author's; no source program ran here.
